_note: Our own data. What the squad does to a place stays done (DESIGN.md: world consequences): facts per hub in story.flags['_world'] ({hub id: {fact: value}}), set by jobs, fights and story effects ({'world': {'set': {...}}}). Rules here turn facts into knock-on effects a mission or two later: shortages, damage, people's moods, and a job to make it right. Consistent with the book's 'stakes change, the world reacts' (Core p.42-43).

text: The taps in {hub} have run dry. People are queueing at the old cisterns, and they know whose doing it was: {what}.
{hub} is rationing water since {what} went down. Nobody says it to your face. Not yet.
banter: We did that. The dam. These people didn't sign up for it.
Every empty bucket in this town is on us.

text: {hub} goes dark at night now, since {what}. The clinic runs on a generator that coughs.
banter: The lights are out because of us.
We could fix this. We should fix this.

text: Shelves are emptying in {hub} since {what}. Prices are up, tempers too.
banter: That depot fed half this town. We should have thought about that.

text: {hub} is patching up {what} after the fighting. Some of the holes are yours.
banter: Lot of broken windows out there.
They'll be sweeping glass for a week.
